crossRefs.note: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.
“These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor…
Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel…
